description: Exploit, a time-neutral accuracy booster. The tip's population mean is now below the bar (held-out 0.7526), so the next time cut needs one first. On the E027 tip (8.75 true epochs, 219 steps at batch 2000, 20/24/28/32 px at 15/25/30/30%), change only the LR warm-up length. First read the current warm-up and peak fraction from the code (airbench96 uses a peak at about 0.23 of steps). Halve it so the peak comes earlier, with the same peak value and a linear decay to the same 0.07 floor, for both the Muon group and the SGD groups. The Lookahead/EMA ramp, resolution phases, epochs, wd and LS all stay unchanged. If LR is a GPU tensor, no recapture is needed; otherwise recapture every resolution in build, with error_on_recompile on. Judge on held-out seeds 3–12 as well as seeds 0–2. Keep only if the held-out gain is at least 0.15 pp and seeds 0–2 clear 0.753.
